title: New poll shows Hochul with double-digit lead over Blakeman - ABC7 New York
text:
New poll shows Hochul with double-digit lead over Blakeman - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut POLITICS 
 Hochul holds 11-point lead over Blakeman, Marist poll finds 
 Stream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7 By Phil Taitt Wednesday, October 28, 2026 8:46AM Share NEW YORK (WABC) -- With Election Day approaching, Gov. Kathy Hochul and Republican challenger Bruce Blakeman are intensifying their campaigns across New York as a new poll shows the incumbent holding a double-digit lead.
 According to a new Marist Poll, Hochul leads Blakeman 53% to 42%, an 11-point advantage in the race for governor. Blakeman, the Nassau County executive, has disputed the findings, saying the poll undersampled Republicans and arguing that the race is closer than the numbers suggest.
 Hochul campaigned in Midtown on Monday alongside members of the Hotel and Gaming Trades Council, where she pointed to strong early voting turnout as a positive sign for Democrats heading into Election Day.
 READ MORE: Voter's Guide 2026 
 Blakeman spent Monday on the Upper East Side, where he continued to criticize congestion pricing, a policy he has pledged to repeal if elected.
 As the campaigns enter their final stretch , both candidates are working to energize supporters ahead of Tuesday's election.

 The governor's race remains one of the highest-profile contests on New York's Election Day ballot.
